## Working memory — issue-239-a3 (Track A / Slice A3), updated 2026-07-11

**Chain**: 3 sequential PRs into `feature/v2.0.0` (all Part of #239, approved). CP-A3a verdict on PR-3.

- **PR-1 = #240** — MERGED into feature/v2.0.0 (tip 35d4ab0, with #238 CP-A2b). Phase 1 + R3 gap fix + class closure (4 sites) + anti-spawn guard.
- **PR-2 = #241** — OPEN, awaiting human review/merge. Branch `feat/issue-239-a3-pr2` (based on 35d4ab0). Phase 2: GitLab `prView`/`mrCreate` un-stub over `gitlabApiFetch` (+additive method/body extension). 1178/1178 tests, 116/400 budget, fresh review clean. 2 work-unit commits. See [[sdd/issue-239-a3/r3-gap-ruling]].
- **NEXT (after #241 merges)**: PR-3 = Phases 3-4 off updated feature/v2.0.0 — shared parameterized contract suite (`vcs.contract.test.mjs`) + recorded-from-real fixtures + `DERIVED` edge cases. **CP-A3a verdict tranche** (fixture-only; CP-A3b live smoke deferred to SCIT). ALSO fold in deferred tasks **3.6** (reconcile all 3 verb sources: required-verbs table + status table + cli.mjs VERBS; add a drift-guard) and **3.7** (canonical empty-body `''`-vs-`null` parity across providers).

**Incident handled this session**: PR-2 branch initially mis-based on 5bdee8b (engram's dirty .memory/*.jsonl aborted the checkout); reset to origin/feature/v2.0.0=35d4ab0 before any work. See [[memory/orphaned-chunks-post-c4]].

**Mirror cleanup (CP-A2b runbook)**: handed exact glab/git commands to human — close 2 test MRs, delete `test/cp-a2b-*` mirror branches, KEEP the `status::approved` fixture issue.

**Standing workflow**: push+PR without asking; only merge is human-gated ([[workflow/push-pr-authorization]]).
